lines: What do you mean? You were held captive by these things!?
It was a horrible world... all the indigenous species had either been killed or enslaved by those Octo-guys!!!
≪C-Calm yourselves! Those were bad Brain Flayers!≫
≪I, Arsal, am different! I'm an environmental conservationist, I'm on your side!≫
...That's what he's been saying, Shikanosuke. He says he cares about the indigenous creatures.
That's a lie!! I heard it all before. At first these Octo-guys pretend to be friendly!
They say they'll provide technologies and stuff like that, and when you let your guard down, they suddenly attack!!!
I see. The same methods the invaders in the age of imperialism used. That means the environmental conservationists are more like missionaries.
The Brain Flayer slowly stepped back.
Taimanin are not naive enough to be manipulated by the likes of an octopus, you know?
But if we take him down, we can't go back to...
Don't try to stop me, little brother.
Set aside personal feelings and slay that which is pure evilー Rinko-senpai's face showed that kind of righteous determination.
Well, I feel the same way...!
I guess this world was similar to ours. I was sad that I wouldn't get to see Tokiko or Hebiko again, but things would work out one way or another.
In the end, let's just eliminate the bad octopus♪
All four of us pointed our blades at the Brain Flayer.
≪When all is said and done, you are just lower lifeforms. I would have even taken you on as my slaves if you had just followed my plan to protect the environment.≫
≪I thought it would be useful to have clever slaves, but... Oh well, I'm sure I can find plenty of replacements!!!≫
The Brain Flayer uttered something in an alien-sounding language.
≪Kukukukuku!! I won't be going through that trouble again!!≫
Dog!? You call this a dog!?
≪Come on, here's your food, my watchdogs!!!≫
As if we're gonna let that happen...!!! I'm gonna cut you all into pieces!
